text.autoconfig.wrenchfinder-client.opti: Main Hand Handling
Choose whether the previous main-hand stack is stored away or directly swapped.
Fallback To Block Item
If no rule matches, use the block's own item form as the lookup target.
Show Failure Messages
Show chat messages when a lookup cannot complete.
Rules
Rules are checked from top to bottom.
Each rule contains one block pattern and an ordered list of item patterns. Wildcards are supported.
Rule Entry
Block Pattern
The aimed block id or wildcard pattern, for example minecraft:furnace or minecraft:*_planks.
Leave no blank rules behind; empty rules are removed on save.
Item Patterns
Ordered item ids or wildcard patterns to search for.
The first available matching item across supported storage sources will be equipped.
Item Pattern
Pattern
Enter an item id or wildcard pattern such as minecraft:crafting_table or minecraft:*_planks.
Rules are checked in order, and the first available match will be equipped.
